messages:
maria huang: quick sanity check — planning to enable per-customer flag for ZenithCorp behind contract gate. target: org_id=zenith, rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50%, initial canary = just their dev team. Any objections? :thinking:

alex chen: fine by me. who's owning the rollout steps? want a PR link + opt-out plan.

samir patel: pinging infra — will 2% be stable with batching? we had previously hit quota spikes when small orgs burst.

katie wong: infra-side: we need to set rate_limit_override for zenith org while canary is on. I'll open infra ticket. Also suggest adding a kill-switch scoped to account.

flagbot: rule-change detected: new flag `customer.zenith.beta_v2` created by @maria. docs: /flags/customer.zenith.beta_v2

maria huang: PR: https://github.com/redwood/flags/pull/312 — includes flag key `customer.zenith.beta_v2`. I'll own rollout and smoke. Opt-out: add `zenith:force_disable=true` in entitlement table.

maria huang: config snippet (ops):
```
flag: customer.zenith.beta_v2
scope: org:zenith
rollout: [2,10,50]
kill_switch: true
contract_gate: signed_sla_v2
```

alex chen: code review done. left one comment about audit metadata and eventing on enable/disable. once katie confirms rate limit override, i'll approve and merge.

katie wong: opened infra ticket I-4273, added temporary quota bump + guardrail to auto-fallback to `customer.default` if p95 latency > 800ms for 5m. Also attached quick rollback play: `flagsctl set customer.zenith.beta_v2=false --scope org:zenith`.

samir patel: noted. please add a monitoring eval prompt set for Zenith's 50k/day calls — want quality baseline and hallucination checks.

maria huang: will add evals and a canary dashboard widget. plan to start 2% tomorrow 10:00 PT. tagging @alex @katie for final thumbs.

alex chen: :thumbsup:

katie wong: :thumbsup:
